author: Jesper Rønn-Jensen
html:
Just to clarify: I don't think that Rails has become more "enterprise ready"... On the contrary, **enterprises are becoming Rails ready**.

There is an important distinction here, and with built-in Rails support for web services, and easy apis, it's only a question of time before real good reasons must occur for not choosing Ruby on Rails.
